# TuskWise

> TuskWise is a free, original educational website about elephants: the African savanna elephant, the African forest elephant and the Asian elephant. It covers how to tell the species apart, anatomy, family life and behavior, intelligence and memory research, habitats and diet, conservation status and population estimates, and how to see elephants ethically in the wild. Every page cites reputable sources such as the IUCN, WWF, accredited zoos and peer reviewed studies. Operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC.

The content is general education. Population figures are the latest published estimates and are dated on each page.

## Tools
- [African vs Asian elephant comparison](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html): side by side comparison table of the African savanna, African forest and Asian elephant (ears, tusks, trunk, back, size, range, diet, IUCN status, population) with deep links
  - Sections: [Comparison table](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html#table), [Ears](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html#ears), [Tusks](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html#tusks), [Trunk tip](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html#trunk), [Back and head shape](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html#shape), [Size](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html#size), [Range and habitat](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html#range), [Status and population](https://tuskwise.com/african-vs-asian-elephant.html#status)
- [Is this elephant sanctuary ethical? Checklist](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html): practical checklist for judging any captive elephant venue (riding, bathing, performing, bullhooks, chaining, breeding, trade, contact, transparency) based on World Animal Protection, ABTA and GFAS standards; no venues are named
  - Sections: [Quick test](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#quick-test), [Riding](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#riding), [Bathing and washing](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#bathing), [Shows and performing](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#performing), [Bullhooks and training](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#bullhooks), [Chaining and living space](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#chaining), [Breeding](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#breeding), [Buying, selling and renting elephants](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#trade), [Contact, feeding and photos](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#contact), [Transparency](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#transparency), [How to vet a venue before booking](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#vetting), [Printable checklist](https://tuskwise.com/elephant-sanctuary-checklist.html#printable)

## Guides
- [African forest elephant](https://tuskwise.com/african-forest-elephant.html): Central and West Africa's rainforest elephant: features, fruit diet and seed dispersal, 2024 population estimate, Critically Endangered status
- [African savanna elephant](https://tuskwise.com/african-savanna-elephant.html): the largest land animal: size, habitats, diet, family life, lifespan and Endangered status
- [Elephant anatomy](https://tuskwise.com/anatomy.html): trunk, tusks, molars, ears, skin, legs, feet and brain explained with sources
  - Sections: [Trunk](https://tuskwise.com/anatomy.html#trunk), [Tusks](https://tuskwise.com/anatomy.html#tusks), [Teeth](https://tuskwise.com/anatomy.html#teeth), [Ears](https://tuskwise.com/anatomy.html#ears), [Skin](https://tuskwise.com/anatomy.html#skin), [Legs and feet](https://tuskwise.com/anatomy.html#feet), [Brain](https://tuskwise.com/anatomy.html#brain)
- [Asian elephant](https://tuskwise.com/asian-elephant.html): features, tusks and tushes, 13 range countries, diet, family life, population estimates (including India's 2025 DNA based count) and Endangered status
- [Elephant behavior and social life](https://tuskwise.com/behavior.html): matriarch led families, bulls and musth, calves, infrasound rumbles, seismic signals, name like calls, sleep and responses to the dead
  - Sections: [Family groups](https://tuskwise.com/behavior.html#family), [Bulls and musth](https://tuskwise.com/behavior.html#bulls), [Calves](https://tuskwise.com/behavior.html#calves), [Communication](https://tuskwise.com/behavior.html#communication), [Sleep](https://tuskwise.com/behavior.html#sleep), [Death](https://tuskwise.com/behavior.html#death)
- [Elephant conservation](https://tuskwise.com/conservation.html): IUCN status, latest population estimates, poaching and ivory trade, habitat loss, human elephant conflict, CITES and what helps
  - Sections: [Status](https://tuskwise.com/conservation.html#status), [Numbers](https://tuskwise.com/conservation.html#numbers), [Poaching](https://tuskwise.com/conservation.html#poaching), [Habitat loss](https://tuskwise.com/conservation.html#habitat), [Conflict](https://tuskwise.com/conservation.html#conflict), [Captivity and tourism](https://tuskwise.com/conservation.html#captivity), [What helps](https://tuskwise.com/conservation.html#helps)
- [Where to see elephants ethically](https://tuskwise.com/ethical-viewing.html): wild viewing in national parks, how to judge a true sanctuary, red flags (rides, shows, bathing, chains), and safety around wild elephants
  - Sections: [In the wild](https://tuskwise.com/ethical-viewing.html#wild), [Places known for elephants](https://tuskwise.com/ethical-viewing.html#places), [Sanctuaries](https://tuskwise.com/ethical-viewing.html#sanctuaries), [Red flags](https://tuskwise.com/ethical-viewing.html#red-flags), [Safety](https://tuskwise.com/ethical-viewing.html#safety)
- [Elephant FAQ and myths](https://tuskwise.com/faq.html): quick sourced answers to common elephant questions and myths
- [Elephant glossary](https://tuskwise.com/glossary.html): plain English definitions of elephant terms
- [Elephant habitats, range and diet](https://tuskwise.com/habitats.html): habitats and range of each species, daily food and water needs, home ranges, mineral licks and range loss
  - Sections: [Savanna elephant habitat](https://tuskwise.com/habitats.html#savanna), [Forest elephant habitat](https://tuskwise.com/habitats.html#forest), [Asian elephant habitat](https://tuskwise.com/habitats.html#asian), [Diet](https://tuskwise.com/habitats.html#diet), [Water](https://tuskwise.com/habitats.html#water), [Shrinking range](https://tuskwise.com/habitats.html#range-loss)
- [Elephant intelligence and memory](https://tuskwise.com/intelligence.html): evidence on elephant cognition: mirror self recognition, cooperation, tool use, name like calls, voice discrimination, memory and its limits

## Classroom
- [Elephant adaptations worksheet](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/elephant-adaptations-worksheet.html): printable adaptations worksheet matching elephant structures to their functions, with a writing prompt and answer key
- [Elephant anatomy label the diagram worksheet](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/elephant-anatomy-worksheet.html): printable label the diagram worksheet with an original elephant line drawing, word bank and answer key
- [Elephant quiz with answer key](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/elephant-quiz.html): ten question elephant quiz with a printable answer key; every answer is sourced on TuskWise
- [Elephant species fact sheet](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/elephant-species-fact-sheet.html): printable one page fact sheet comparing the three living elephant species
- [Elephant worksheets and lesson plans](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/): free print friendly elephant worksheets, NGSS tagged lesson ideas for K to 12, a quiz with an answer key and a vocabulary list
  - Sections: [Printables](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/#printables), [Lesson ideas](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/#lessons), [Quiz](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/#quiz), [Vocabulary](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/#vocabulary), [Classroom games](https://tuskwise.com/teachers/#games)
- [Research papers for students and researchers](https://tuskwise.com/research/): 23 peer reviewed elephant studies with authors, year, journal and Crossref verified DOIs, grouped by theme, each linked to the TuskWise page that uses it
  - Sections: [Species and evolution](https://tuskwise.com/research/#species-and-evolution), [Memory, families and leadership](https://tuskwise.com/research/#memory-families-and-leadership), [Intelligence and communication](https://tuskwise.com/research/#intelligence-and-communication), [Body, brain, sleep and reproduction](https://tuskwise.com/research/#body-brain-sleep-and-reproduction), [Ecology](https://tuskwise.com/research/#ecology), [Conservation and welfare](https://tuskwise.com/research/#conservation-and-welfare)

## Blog
- [Can elephants recognize themselves in a mirror?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/can-elephants-recognize-themselves-in-a-mirror.html): evidence on elephant mirror self-recognition (Plotnik, de Waal and Reiss 2006, PNAS), the earlier negative result (Povinelli 1989), and comparison with chimpanzees (Gallup 1970) and dolphins (Reiss and Marino 2001)
- [Do elephants have names for each other?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/do-elephants-have-names-for-each-other.html): evidence that African elephants address each other with individually specific name-like calls (Pardo et al. 2024, Nature Ecology & Evolution), plus vocal learning context (Poole 2005; Stoeger 2012; Soltis 2010)
- [Do elephants mourn their dead?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/do-elephants-mourn-their-dead.html): elephant responses to dying and dead conspecifics (Douglas-Hamilton et al. 2006; McComb et al. 2005; Goldenberg and Wittemyer 2020 review; Sharma et al. 2020 Asian elephants), including interest in skulls and ivory and care around carcasses
- [Do elephants really never forget?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/do-elephants-really-never-forget.html): what peer reviewed studies show about elephant memory (McComb 2001, 2011, 2014; Foley 2008) and its limits
- [Do elephants use tools?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/do-elephants-use-tools.html): elephant tool use and tool modification (Chevalier-Skolnikoff and Liska 1993; Hart and Hart 1994; Hart et al. 2001 fly switches; Foerder et al. 2011 insightful cube platform; Barrett and Benson-Amram 2020 water as tool; Urban et al. 2024 hose showering)
- [How do elephants communicate over long distances?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/how-do-elephants-communicate-over-long-distances.html): how elephants use infrasonic rumbles (Payne, Langbauer and Thomas 1986; Garstang 2004), how the larynx makes them (Herbst et al. 2012, Science), and seismic detection of calls through the ground (O'Connell-Rodwell et al. 2006, 2007)
- [How long are elephants pregnant?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/how-long-are-elephants-pregnant.html): elephant gestation (about 22 months), how it is maintained (Lueders 2012), calf size, birth intervals and conservation implications
- [How long do elephants live?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/how-long-do-elephants-live.html): elephant lifespan and survival in the wild, timber camps and zoos (Moss 2001 Amboseli demography; Lee et al. 2016 longevity in wild females; Clubb et al. 2008 zoo survivorship; Mumby et al. 2013 climate and survival; Lahdenpera et al. 2014 and 2018 Myanmar Asian elephants; Abegglen et al. 2015 TP53 cancer resistance)
- [How long do elephants sleep?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/how-long-do-elephants-sleep.html): how long elephants sleep and whether they sleep standing up (Gravett et al. 2017 wild African matriarchs, about 2 hours a day; Tobler 1992 captive Asian elephants; Holdgate et al. 2016 zoo recumbence; Siegel 2005 sleep and body size)
- [How many elephants are left in the world?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/how-many-elephants-are-left.html): latest published population estimates for all three species (IUCN 2016, 2020, 2024 reports; India 2025), with caveats
- [Is it ethical to ride an elephant?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/is-it-ethical-to-ride-elephants.html): welfare evidence on elephant rides (World Animal Protection 2017 survey of 2,923 elephants), why bathing is no better, and alternatives
- [Tusker Kavantissa dies in Sri Lanka](https://tuskwise.com/blog/sri-lanka-tusker-kavantissa-dies-after-gunshot-wound.html): news, 18 Oct 2026: death of Sri Lankan wild tusker Kavantissa after a gunshot wound, court-ordered post-mortem, and context on tuskers and human-elephant conflict
- [Why are some elephants born without tusks?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/why-are-some-elephants-born-without-tusks.html): tusklessness in African elephants and how ivory poaching and genetic drift made it more common (Campbell-Staton et al. 2021 Gorongosa; Jachmann et al. 1995 Luangwa; Chiyo et al. 2015 tusk size decline in Kenya; Whitehouse 2002 Addo)
- [Why do elephants have such big ears?](https://tuskwise.com/blog/why-do-elephants-have-big-ears.html): how elephant ears work as radiators, why African ears are larger than Asian, hearing and ear signals
